[QUERENT] Have I Been Trained

[SYSTEM] You can check if your visual artwork or photos were included in popular AI image-generation datasets by visiting [Have I Been Trained?](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVQHrOzAV66hynBdGmhbi1fWwIh_2CBJW3oC3s4Z1nlzwj7gaIS20SAEDldBD3DBA1DAwsD6kF9YlQi9h_IfGPjLrAfiomtvo3h_6vbuh_qoT08IsFmU). What the Tool Does

* Dataset Searched: It queries the LAION-5B dataset, a massive collection of roughly 5.8 billion image-text pairs used to train open-source image models like Stable Diffusion. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHrOzAVq90zC71QhcygYkXaoT1D0X2ldmwMchqClJSN734U2q5Bh7w1tb2WB5oZPhJAkMyGJcT6mWM_iH77xFf6WTJ3RFODtIPcaqcwgPCQXbtWzF8ulGP_L3gXOnRFMFmA8W2YeJI6aOSg6IkNP9QTyaFTbDDbbrz6c1Jv), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVpwIsr5WmrA10Ck_xGdtTHde7VblEtWFeWv1Ni1DI4y-DzkGJHz7_PlH4y837t96oBjJkZM4laHs1GfgyxKCoRkJFOW7zDxi8Bl69ODpWIqlrqSOiwduJrELrwXy5Nrm6EN2PXes_X0mG_NSafY3SeQ)]
* How to Check: You can search the database by typing in your name or keywords, or by uploading an image to look for visual matches. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAV4hiiEbKam_WjJlu8MxZrFtSazw91AYKZqiOEOza2tZANr5liTIYhlCuH7KVIJUmMi7wIz--cDkr67vQZaarC6J2mwCrLr7SOupQWBXo6UFtqP6qmdYB7nEiTMui36A), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVpwIsr5WmrA10Ck_xGdtTHde7VblEtWFeWv1Ni1DI4y-DzkGJHz7_PlH4y837t96oBjJkZM4laHs1GfgyxKCoRkJFOW7zDxi8Bl69ODpWIqlrqSOiwduJrELrwXy5Nrm6EN2PXes_X0mG_NSafY3SeQ)]
* Limitations: It only covers the LAION-5B image dataset. It does not search text-based training data used by large language models like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVpwIsr5WmrA10Ck_xGdtTHde7VblEtWFeWv1Ni1DI4y-DzkGJHz7_PlH4y837t96oBjJkZM4laHs1GfgyxKCoRkJFOW7zDxi8Bl69ODpWIqlrqSOiwduJrELrwXy5Nrm6EN2PXes_X0mG_NSafY3SeQ)]

How to Opt Out

* Do Not Train Registry: Spawning AI allows you to submit your work or domain to their Do Not Train Registry to block future inclusion. * Text Content: For written text or websites, you can use a `robots.txt` file to block known AI scrapers (such as GPTBot or Google-Extended). findings: THE SERVICE GIVEN AS WORKING. 'It queries the LAION-5B dataset' and 'You can search the database by typing in your name or keywords, or by uploading an image to look for visual matches.' The census row's saved pages, the home page and the /faq address alike: 'Spawning Under Maintenance Hacking the mainframe...', with its lifecycle 'paused' and the sources 'refetched at 05:07 UTC on 2026-11-01'. The composition says nothing of the maintenance. The second card's title asks 'What happened to have i been trained website?'; the first and fourth date themselves 2026 ('Free Tool to Check AI Training Data (2026)', 'Have I Been Trained? Review 2026').

WHAT IT SEARCHES, FROM NO SAVED SOURCE. The census row's kind: 'not recorded in the saved sources'. The composition supplies one, a search of 'LAION-5B', 'roughly 5.8 billion image-text pairs used to train open-source image models like Stable Diffusion', with the toolcenter card ('a web-based search tool that lets you query the LAION-5B dataset — a collection of approximately 5.8 billio...'). Neither the dataset nor the figure is on a saved page.

THE REGISTRY, ITS ADDRESSEE TURNED. 'Spawning AI allows you to submit your work or domain to their Do Not Train Registry to block future inclusion.' The saved page addresses the registry to the receiving side: 'AI trainers looking to respect the Do-Not-Train registry, please reach out to us at'. The census row reads it the same way, as 'addressed to AI trainers, the receiving party'. The composition addresses it to the maker of a work and says it blocks; the page asks trainers to respect it.

TEXT OUTSIDE ITS REACH. 'It only covers the LAION-5B image dataset. It does not search text-based training data used by large language models like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.' For 'written text or websites' the composition sends the user to 'a robots.txt file to block known AI scrapers (such as GPTBot or Google-Extended)'. The census row places the service on 'the training side of the layer' with 'the discovery function its name promises' unread; by the composition's account the discovery it offers is of images, and a written work is answered with a crawler directive.
